detail: FINS-547 preschool salmon and meat intervention. Peg test is inconclusive. Registry and abstract have different enrollment counts.
FINS query retrieves an overlapping author on the separate PINGU infant feeding study. The report compares fatty acid biomarkers.
The abstract concerns intranasal calcitonin and recovery after hip surgery, not a whole salmon meal or the requested registry family.
The abstract reviews osteoporotic vertebral fractures and lists calcitonin as a class of treatment. It does not report the mixed-fish study.
Found through the PINGU study name and primary-arm comparison. The authors report no clear group difference in the Bayley psychomotor index.
